description: A bus rammed into the pavement near Hongik University Station in Seoul on Saturday, injuring six people. The bus veered onto the pavement and crashed into a structure following a collision involving another bus and a sedan at around 6:57 p.m. in the busy entertainment district. Six people were taken to hospitals for treatment after sustaining injuries. No deaths or serious injuries have been reported. Police and fire authorities were looking into the exact cause of the accident. (Yonhap)
title: Bus rams into pavement near Hongik University Station, injuring 6

description: Anthropic’s record-breaking Nasdaq debut has fueled expectations for a potential IPO by rival OpenAI, despite concerns over AI valuations. description: Foreign investors are staging a mass exodus from South Korean equities while pouring money into domestic bonds, signaling a sharp shift in investment flows.
